facts.fact: The Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of Health, opening the 12th Tanzania Health Summit, said the country now has for the first time an integrated electronic medical records system linking a patient's information from community level through health centres and district hospitals to national level; no facility counts are given and dispensaries are not named.
